train_split_note: The 29 training episodes ARE exactly reproducible: downsample_mask over get_split_masks_3way at train_ratio=0.2, seed=42, recorded verbatim in config/splits/pusht_seed42_legacy_val10_train29.json (verified index-for-index). What is missing is provenance IN THIS DIRECTORY -- these runs predate splits.json, so nothing on disk ties these checkpoints to those episodes.
caveats: use_ema: False -- every number from this run comes from the LIVE weights, while all 100-demo numbers come from the EMA average (decay 0.995). Different weights, not just different data.

No policy-level crop: crop_shape/random_crop were unset, so cropping happened only inside the encoder's CropRandomizer and an observation and the subgoal images derived from it received INDEPENDENT crop offsets at train time -- they were translated relative to each other. This is a correctness defect for the subgoal_* contexts specifically; the 100-demo arms fixed it by putting one offset in scope for the whole search.
val split is 10 episodes (SE ~9.5pp at p=0.9), so its checkpoint selection is weak: three of these arms tied at 9/10 while their test numbers were 84 / 70 / 32%.
